{{Quote|Listen up! Since this is Jango's first mission as a squad commander, we're keeping it simple. The job's a routine extraction mission.|Jaster Mereel on Jango Fett|<ref name="JFOS2">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 2|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Squad Commander''' was a position among the [[True Mandalorians]] that allowed one to lead a [[Squad]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was assigned the position by ''[[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mand'alor]]'' [[Jaster Mereel]].<ref name="JFOS2" />
